newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore cleaning up after water main break.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore cleaning up after water main break.

text.p: Baltimore officials said it would cost hundreds of thousands of dollars and will take months to repair the damage from a broken water main in North Baltimore.
Repair crews are on the scene to begin the clean up work after thousands of gallons of water spilled onto 20th Street near North Avenue over the weekend.
Seventeen homes were condemned, several have already been demolished, and dozens more have suffered some water damage.
At least 80 residents are now homeless and have lost all their belongings. A 20-block area is closed to traffic this morning.
The cause of the break has still not been determined.
